#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    int ans = 0;
    int start = 0;
    int end = 0;
    int len = input.length();
    while (start < len) {
        end = start;
        char ch = input[start];
        while (end < len && input[end] == ch) {
            end++;
        }
        int groupSize = end - start;
        if (groupSize % 2 == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        start = end;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
